title: FloodGuard Policy Fee Share Returned When the Property Is Sold
content:
**Fee schedule note — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy policy fee on a sale**

Part of the tier's policy fee is returned on a cancellation because the property was sold: one half (0.5) of the policy fee when the policy had been continuously insured since its original effective date for at least 60 months by the cancellation date; one quarter (0.25) of the policy fee when for fewer than 60 months; and nothing on any other cancellation.

The months are counted from the policy's original effective date — its first coverage start — to the cancellation date.

| Reason stated on the cancellation request | Months continuously insured by the cancellation date | Share of the policy fee returned |
|---|---|---|
| Property sold | 60 or more | 0.5 |
| Property sold | fewer than 60 | 0.25 |
| Any other reason | any | none |

**Hypothetical examples,** each on a policy fee of 50.00:

| Case | Share | Returned |
|---|---|---|
| Sold after 61 months | 0.5 | 25.00 |
| Sold after exactly 60 months | 0.5 | 25.00 |
| Sold after 59 months | 0.25 | 12.50 |
| Loan paid off after 100 months | none | nothing |
